notes: Audit-completion car closing the three control-plane gaps. The structured path tools (write_file/edit_file — local registry, execute_code helpers and the ACP fs proxy) now refuse the body/config paths a human or a lint-gated command owns: constitution, skills and memory under the active body root AND the shared overlay copy, the active settings file, web/settings.json and any profiles/<name>/settings.json (cross-profile clobber), with honest refusals that point at /learn or the propose-only plan — reads stay open and run_bash stays the declared boundary it was. Natural-language cron gains per-job controls on all four entries (the /cron command, the model `cron` tool, the ops CLI and POST /api/cron) through one set of scheduler helpers: pause/resume, a manual run that never eats a future one-shot, and a per-job missed-window policy — catch-up off skips windows stale beyond five minutes instead of firing them late (interval anchors advance without a burst, a missed one-shot is honestly marked missed), while the default keeps the original fire-late-once behavior byte-identical. The console chat gains message-level rewind and fork: edit a past question and resend from that point (the old transcript is archived first, crash-safe temp+rename), or branch a new session from any message with the live transcript untouched; Telegram gains /rewind — reply-targeted or the last n visible messages — and the bot menu grows to twelve commands from the same source of truth.
